entities.name: Online Bookstore System
entities.description: An Amazon-style e-commerce platform enabling users to browse, search, and purchase physical and electronic books with integrated reviews and recommendations.

entities.name: Customer / Reviewer
entities.description: End-users browsing catalogues, purchasing items, managing carts, and submitting 5-star ratings.

entities.name: Store Administrator
entities.description: Internal personnel managing catalogue integrity, fulfillment, and GDPR/CCPA compliance.

entities.name: Payment Gateway
entities.description: External service processing secure multi-currency checkouts (USD, EUR, GBP).

entities.name: Shipping / Fulfillment Provider
entities.description: External API handling physical book logistics.

entities.name: Identity Provider
entities.description: AWS Cognito / Auth0 managing customer authentication and OIDC/OAuth 2.0 flows.

entities.name: Notification Service
entities.description: AWS SES / SendGrid delivering order confirmations and review prompts.
